excerpts: Hello, everyone, and thanks for joining us.
The all-new iPad mini features a stunning new OLED display and brings a super thin design to the smallest member of the iPad family.
We launched Siri AI in beta for US English users in September and expanded to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in October.
I’m feeling great about the opportunities ahead for Apple, from our product roadmap and broad range of services to promising areas like health, emerging markets, enterprise, and education.
They’re going to deploy 170,000 MacBook Neos to teachers and staff.
We’ve assembled an extraordinary collection of talent—the best engineers, designers, developers, and experts in every corner of our business from our supply chain to our stores.
That’s the Apple experience customers love.
It is a completely re-imagined assistant that is powerful, personal, private, and deeply relevant to our users’ daily lives.
iPhone remains at the center of our opportunity as the intelligent personal hub.
It’s always with you and understands your personal context from your messages to your photos, notes, and apps to deliver powerful intelligence right when you need it.
We grew in the vast majority of markets we track, setting September quarter records in the Americas, Europe, Greater China, and the rest of Asia-Pacific.
We grew strong double digits in the U.S. and greater China to achieve September quarter revenue records.
From the very beginning, we knew what we wanted to create: a foldable form factor with a larger display that feels as natural and intuitive as iPad.
The result is a series of remarkable innovations that we believe will redefine what a foldable phone can be.
Our latest models feature a dramatically improved camera system with breakthrough upgrades like variable aperture and all-new photographic styles.
The A20 Pro and next-generation vapor chamber together deliver the highest sustained performance in iPhone history.
A20 Pro also features a new dual 16-core neural engine accelerating on-device AI and computational photography.
Turning to Mac, revenue was $10.8 billion, up 24% from a year ago despite supply constraints.
Last week, we introduced a whole new way for people to experience Mac.

Anywhere our users go, there’s a place for iPad, like a classroom where it helps students explore the world in amazing ways, or a design studio, giving artists and creatives an expansive canvas to explore their ideas.
Apple Watch makes the simple act of wearing a watch a powerful way to help take care of your health.
Paired with the S11 chip, Apple’s most powerful wearable chip, the health sensing system delivers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable.
We were also happy to unveil new features like health age and readiness, which will tell you when to push forward or hold back, as well as the all-new Health app redesign.
And we’re excited for Audio Intelligence, which will be coming in a future software update and will help you remember moments you might otherwise miss.
Meanwhile, AirPods 5 offer best-in-class open-ear active noise cancellation at an incredible price while improving sound quality, battery life, and durability.

With iPhone and Apple Intelligence, including Siri AI, AirPods allow users to do remarkable things like connect with someone who’s speaking another language with live translation, or get answers with broad world knowledge entirely hands-free.
The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards were a night to remember for Apple TV, with our shows earning more awards than any other network.
Widow’s Bay, the show of the summer, became the most awarded comedy ever in a single year with 14 wins.
We’re very excited about our programming, from fan favorites like Slow Horses and Ted Lasso to the upcoming film, “Being Human.”
To celebrate the opening of the site in London, we hosted an unforgettable performance by Elton John.
It means designing privacy protections like on-device processing, so personal data stays on a user’s device.
And it means introducing new child safety features to make it easier for parents to manage when and how their kids can use their devices.

Through our American Manufacturing Program, we’re deepening partnerships with suppliers across the country, including Perryman, a titanium producer now supplying iPhone Duo, and Qnity Electronics, which is producing the camera technology behind iPhone 18 Pro’s new variable aperture system.
Nearly 100 components in our newest iPhones come from American companies in more than a dozen states.
All told, Apple supports more than 450,000 American jobs with thousands of suppliers and partners across all 50 states.
It’s all part of our $600 billion four-year commitment to U.S. innovation and advanced manufacturing.
Thanks, Kevan.
Before we get into questions, I’d like to introduce Sabih Khan, Apple’s Chief Operating Officer.

Many of you know Sabih from his work with worldwide operations and supply chain, leading many important functions at Apple, including manufacturing, AppleCare, environmental efforts, and supplier partnerships around the world.
Sabih and his team are the reason we’re able to build and deliver products at a scale and of a caliber unlike anyone else out there.
Yeah, thanks, Michael.
And you mentioned iCloud+.
It’s primarily request-based today, but as we talked about at WWDC, it’s built on a modern orchestrator-driven architecture that gives us real room to expand its capabilities over time.
Another good example of this, in India, we recently launched Apple Pay with Axis Bank, bringing the seamless, safe, secure way to pay to one of the biggest markets in the world.
Yeah, let me give you an overall view on memory.
Now, for the December quarter, we expect even higher memory costs, partly offset by a few factors.
And looking beyond the December quarter, we see the pricing for memory purchases continuing to increase.
According to a survey from WorldPanel, iPhone models were the top three selling smartphones in urban China, and we think we gained share on iPhone and Mac.
So I guess to answer your question, we think the success comes from having really great products.
